sub_scenario.one_line: museum education producer: accept one bounded rehearsal, with deck review replacing additional runs

dialogue.content: I spent the first hour tidying the lesson outline and closing stale entries.
Anything still open?
Two items, both with owners.
The gallery calendar review wrapped early today.
Any surprises in it?
None worth recording.
I can record short label descriptions without losing my voice.
Those are brief and spaced out.
I finish them with plenty of room to recover.
Someone new shadowed me in the education studio this morning.
Did that slow you down?
A little, but the questions were good ones.
I batched my replies about the school visits into one message before lunch.
Cleaner than drip-feeding answers.
Much cleaner.
On 12 March, I led a two-hour rehearsal for the new sculpture tour after sending the team a marked-up route and timing sheet.
How did the next day's tour sound?
Clear and steady; the live run was the only long speaking block.
When a program is dense, I make an annotated slide deck first.
Could that replace part of a live rehearsal?
Yes, the presenters can comment on it before we meet.
I archived last cycle's notes on the gallery calendar and set up the new folder.
A fresh start?
As fresh as these things get.
The same week I moderated a casual staff lunch with no agenda.
That was also speaking in a group.
It was conversational, not projected narration for two hours.
A vendor call about the lesson outline ran long but ended well.
Worth the time?
This one, yes.
I walked through the education studio checklist with the new starter.
How did they do?
Careful and quick, a good sign.
Quiet afternoon; I cleared the backlog around the school visits.
A rare day.
I did not waste it.
I flagged a small inconsistency in the gallery calendar records and fixed it at the source.
Root cause or symptom?
Root cause, for once.
On 7 April, three back-to-back read-throughs left my throat rough before the 09:30 school-group tour the next morning.
What affected the tour?
I had to shorten explanations because projection hurt.
I sketched next week's plan for the school visits before leaving.
Ahead of schedule?
Ahead enough to sleep well.
Lunch walk, then a clean pass through the lesson outline updates.
Does the walk help?
It resets the afternoon.
Seasonal reflux has been waking me early, so an evening of extended speech gives me less recovery than usual.
Is rest part of keeping your voice clear?
Yes, I am following the clinician's advice to protect it.
I compared two options for the gallery calendar tooling and noted a mild preference.
Decision made?
Deferred until the trial ends.
I closed the week by updating the education studio handover notes.
Anything unusual to hand over?
Blessedly little.
The team wants a 17:00–19:00 live rehearsal on Thursday before my Friday morning school tour. Is that a good fit for me?
